mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM graph_maintenance_run WHERE run_type = 'FULL_REBUILD' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED') )

SELECT e.id FROM graph_outbox_event e WHERE e.status = 'PENDING' AND e.next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM graph_outbox_event earlier WHERE earlier.achievement_id = e.achievement_id AND earlier.desired_version < e.desired_version AND earlier.status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') ) ORDER BY e.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE graph_outbox_event SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', completed_at = #{now}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_summary = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND locked_by = #{workerId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE graph_outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_summary = #{errorSummary} WHERE id = #{id} AND locked_by = #{workerId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE graph_outbox_event SET status = 'DEAD', attempts = attempts + 1, completed_at = #{failedAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_summary = #{errorSummary} WHERE id = #{id} AND locked_by = #{workerId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO graph_sync_dead_letter (event_id, error_code, error_summary, failed_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{errorCode}, #{errorSummary}, #{failedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT achievement_id FROM graph_outbox_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'DEAD'
